children: Doha: Qatar Airways on Wednesday issued a travel alert warning passengers of flight disruptions following a system failure affecting air traffic control in the United Kingdom.
The airline said flights to and from UK airports, as well as services operating through UK airspace, are experiencing delays and may be subject to rerouting.
Passengers have been advised to check the latest flight information through the Qatar Airways website and mobile app before travelling.
The carrier did not specify how long the disruption is expected to continue.
